answer: Make every agent carry sybil insurance: to earn, an identity must buy a policy from an independent underwriter agent, who pays a large claim if it is later proven to be a duplicate. Underwriters price risk by inspecting history, so a fresh juniper sapling with no record pays a steep premium, while a long-lived agent on a proven terrace pays little. A farm launching an ocean of clones must either pay sky-high premiums for each fake or self-insure, putting its own capital on the line for every copy.
